cd /workspace/tmp && python3 -c "
import json, random
rng = random.Random(9)
n = 48
# build a well connected graph: ring + random chords
links = []
for u in range(n):
    links.append((u, (u+1)%n))
while len(links) < 128:
    u = rng.randrange(n); v = rng.randrange(n)
    if u != v and (u,v) not in links and (v,u) not in links:
        links.append((u,v))
parts = rng.sample(range(n), 32)
r = {v: 1 for v in parts}
env = [[l, 1] for l in range(len(links))]
req = {'op':'load','n':n,'links':[[u,v,10] for (u,v) in links],'bookings':[]}
reqs = [req, {'op':'prepare','id':'P1','owner':'o','window':[0,10],'period':1,
   'participants':[[v,r[v]] for v in parts],'envelope':env,'rev':0}]
open('big2.jsonl','w').write('\n'.join(json.dumps(x) for x in reqs)+'\n')
print('links', len(links))
" && time (python3 -I -B /workspace/submission/main.py < big2.jsonl > big2.out; head -c 300 big2.out; echo; wc -c big2.out)
